errors.error_description: Used logical AND (&&) instead of bitwise AND (&) for a vector operation, producing a 1-bit result expanded to WIDTH.
In next-state combinational logic, an if branch assigns next_state without an else or default path, inferring a latch.
Included a full-width combinational multiplication for the ALU result, potentially inferring a large multiplier with poor area/timing.
Declared an FSM state (ERR) that is never reachable by any transition, making it an unreachable state.
